g.text: Kit signed with the private key
Signature verifies with the public key
Unsigned or tampered kit and a wrong key are refused
cmd: just cosign-supply-check | pass: cosign sign exits 0 for the pushed digest (key pair generated in a scratch directory)
cmd: just cosign-supply-check | pass: prints 'signed-verifies: rc=0 digest=sha256:...'
cmd: just cosign-supply-check | pass: prints 'unsigned-or-tampered: rc=<non-zero> no_signatures_found=True', 'signed-digest-after-tag-overwrite: rc=0' and 'wrong-public-key: rc=<non-zero>'
cmd: just cosign-supply-check | pass: prints 'PASS cosign-supply' and podman ps -a lists no wattson-cosign-registry
